rules.offset: LRC convention: [offset:+n] shows the lyrics n ms sooner, so startMs = stamp - n (n may be negative). This is NOT the app's karaoke offset (backend: positive = lyrics later).
rules.multiStamp: a line with several stamps appears once per stamp
rules.emptyStamp: a stamp without text is a break: it ends the previous line and is not a line
rules.blankLine: a blank line without a stamp is ignored
rules.text: trimmed; order of the result is by startMs
rules.noStamps: a file without any time stamp is unusable (typed 'unusable' error, data-model 2.4 text)
